english translation text: HE WAS THE SUCCESSOR OF THE HOLY PROPHET, FROM THE HOUSE OF ALLAH

arabic text: WOH NABI (SAW) KA JAANASHIN THAA WOH ALI (AS) MARA GAYA
english translation text: HE WAS THE SUCCESSOR OF THE HOLY PROPHET, IT IS THAT ALI WHO HAS BEEN MARTYRED

arabic text: MASJID E KUFA SEY LOGON AA RAHI HAI YE SADA
english translation text: O PEOPLE, A CRY IS HEARD FROM MASJID AL-KUFA

arabic text: JIS KI AAMAD KAY LEEYE DEEWAREY KAABA SHAK HUE\nHALAT E SAJDA MEY USKA, KHOON MASJID MEY BAHA\nMASJID E KUFA SEY LOGON AA RAHI HAI YE SADA
english translation text: THE ONE FOR WHOSE ARRIVAL THE WALL OF THE KA’BA SPLIT,\nHIS BLOOD WAS SHED WHEN HE WAS IN SAJDA (PROSTRATION)\nO PEOPLE, A CRY IS HEARD FROM MASJID AL-KUFA

arabic text: SAAZISH E AHLEY SAQIFA KAAM APNA KAR GAYEE\nAAJ SAJDEY MEY ALI (AS) PAR, CHAL GAYEE TEGHEY JAFAA\nMASJID E KUFA SEY LOGON AA RAHI HAI YE SADA
english translation text: THE PLOT OF SAQIFA HAS REACHED ITS GOAL TODAY,\nTODAY ALI HAS BEEN STRUCK BY A SWORD IN THE STATE OF PROSTRATION,\nO PEOPLE, A CRY IS HEARD FROM MASJID AL-KUFA

arabic text: KUFIYO KHUSHIYA MANAAO QATL HAIDER (AS) HO GAYE\nKHAANA E ZEHRA (SA) MEY LEKIN, AAJ HAI MATAM BAPAA\nMASJID E KUFA SEY LOGON AA RAHI HAI YE SADA
english translation text: OH PEOPLE OF KUFA, YOU CAN CELEBRATE TODAY, ALI HAS BEEN KILLED,\nBUT TODAY THERE IS MOURNING IN THE HOUSE OF ZAHRA,\nO PEOPLE, A CRY IS HEARD FROM MASJID AL-KUFA

arabic text: KIS TARAH ZAINAB (AS) NEY SUN LI YE QAYAMAT KI KHABR\nHONSLA BIBI KO KOI, DENEY WALA BHI NA THAA\nMASJID E KUFA SEY LOGON AA RAHI HAI YE SADA
english translation text: HOW MUST ZAINAB HAVE HEARD THIS CALAMITOUS NEWS,\nTHERE WAS NO ONE TO GIVE HER ANY CONSOLATION,\nO PEOPLE, A CRY IS HEARD FROM MASJID AL-KUFA

arabic text: AMBIYA NOHA KUNA HAI ROTEY HAI JINNO BASHAR\nJAA RAHA HAI AAJ DUNIYA, SEY ALI (AS) SHER E KHUDA\nMASJID E KUFA SEY LOGON AA RAHI HAI YE SADA
english translation text: THE PROPHETS ARE RECITING EULOGIES, THE JINN & MANKIND ARE\nWEEPING, TODAY ALI, THE LION OF GOD, IS DEPARTING FROM\nTHIS WORLD. O PEOPLE, A CRY IS HEARD FROM MASJID AL-KUFA

arabic text: MOMINO TUM AAJ MILKAR PURSA DO HASNAIN (AS) KO\nUTH GAYA HAI UNKEY SAR SEY, AAJ SAAYA BAAP KA\nMASJID E KUFA SEY LOGON AA RAHI HAI YE SADA
english translation text: O MU’MINEEN, GATHER TOGETHER AND GIVE CONDOLENCES TO IMAM HASAN & HUSAIN,\nTODAY THEY HAVE LOST THE GUARDIANSHIP/PROTECTION OF THEIR BELOVED FATHER,\nO PEOPLE, A CRY IS HEARD FROM MASJID AL-KUFA

arabic text: JAAFRI MUSHKILKUSHA KAY QATL KA NOHA HAI YE\nJOH MUSALLEY PAR USIKAY, KHOON SEY LIKKHA GAYA..\nMASJID E KUFA SEY LOGON AA RAHI HAI YE SADA
english translation text: THIS IS A EULOGY ABOUT THE MARTYRDOM OF MUSHKIL KUSHA (SOLVER OF PROBLEMS) ALI,\nTHAT HAS BEEN WRITTEN ON THE PRAYER MAT WITH HIS OWN BLOOD,\nO PEOPLE, A CRY IS HEARD FROM MASJID AL-KUFA
